contradiction_flag.statement: The retained rho=0.25 benchmark does not show a Fisher-RC query-count advantage. The precision sweep nevertheless shows a fine-precision crossover, without post-hoc threshold or seed changes.

report.conclusion: RC becomes useful only at fine precision in this randomized benchmark.

randomized.posterior: projected particle ADF: normalized log weights on a standardized directional particle cloud, weighted directional moments, rank-one Gaussian moment projection, equal-weight reset every query
